description: This file provides database utility functions for a service booking backend, including connection management, table initialization, data seeding, CRUD operations for bookings, tracking history, and related data.

methods.name: str _utc_now_iso()
methods.description: Return current UTC timestamp in ISO format.

methods.name: str get_db_path()
methods.description: Get SQLite database path from environment variable, defaulting to 'service_booking.sqlite3'.

methods.name: sqlite3.Connection get_connection()
methods.description: Create and return a new sqlite3 connection with foreign key support and row factory enabled.

methods.name: None init_db()
methods.description: Initialize the database by creating required tables and indexes if they do not exist, including migration steps for older database schemas.

methods.name: bool _table_is_empty(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str)
methods.description: Check if a specified table is empty in the provided database connection.

methods.name: None seed_reference_data_if_empty()
methods.description: Seed initial reference data into the database tables if they are currently empty.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] rows_to_dicts(rows: List[sqlite3.Row])
methods.description: Convert a list of sqlite3.Row objects into a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: int add_tracking_event( booking_id: int, status: str, description: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Insert a new tracking history event for a booking; returns the inserted row ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_tracking_history(booking_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve the tracking history events for a specific booking, ordered by timestamp.

methods.name: None ensure_initial_tracking_event_for_booking(booking_id: int)
methods.description: Ensure that a new booking has an initial 'Booking Confirmed' tracking event if none exists.

methods.name: int create_booking(data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Create a new booking record and insert an initial tracking event; returns the booking ID.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_booking(booking_id: int)
methods.description: Fetch detailed booking information by ID, including joined brand, model, and problem names.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_models(brand_id: int)
methods.description: List models filtered by brand ID.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict[str,Any]],int] list_admin_bookings( status: Optional[str] = None, brand_id: Optional[int] = None, model_id: Optional[int] = None, problem_id: Optional[int] = None, search: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0, )
methods.description: Retrieve a filtered list of bookings for admin purposes along with total count.

methods.name: bool update_booking_status_with_history( booking_id: int, status: str, description: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Update a booking's status and log the change in tracking history with an optional description.

methods.name: bool update_booking_status(booking_id: int, status: str)
methods.description: Update the status of a booking; for backward compatibility.

ctags.name: add_tracking_event
ctags.signature: ( booking_id: int, status: str, description: Optional[str] = None )

ctags.name: list_admin_bookings
ctags.signature: ( status: Optional[str] = None, brand_id: Optional[int] = None, model_id: Optional[int] = None, problem_id: Optional[int] = None, search: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0, )

ctags.name: update_booking_status_with_history
ctags.signature: ( booking_id: int, status: str, description: Optional[str] = None )
